_comment: F1 — new page singleton holding every piece of visitor-facing copy across
Same pattern as ticketsPage: plain string/text fields for short informational copy,
arrays of named object types for repeating structured content.
Venue identity does NOT live here — it lives on nationalShow.venue. This document is
'what a visitor needs to plan'; nationalShow is 'what the show is'.
Pinned singleton, _id === type name, per sanity/structure.ts convention.
name: showVisitorInfo
title: Show Visitor Information

fields.name: pendingLabel
fields.title: Pending Label
fields.description: Shown beside any block whose confirmation status is Pending. Reword here and it changes everywhere.

fields.name: researchLabel
fields.title: Research Label
fields.description: Shown beside any block whose confirmation status is Research — verified by the web team, but not confirmed by the committee.

fields.name: airportRoutes
fields.title: Travel From Airports
fields.description: One entry per national airport a visitor might arrive at. Renders nothing if empty.

fields.name: accommodation
fields.title: Accommodation
fields.description: Grouped on the page by distance band. Order within a band follows this array.

fields.name: admissionNote
fields.title: Admission Note
fields.description: Explains how admission works — concessions, door vs advance, re-entry. DO NOT put prices here. Prices live on Ticket Types and are shown on /tickets; this page links there.

fields.name: admissionLinkLabel
fields.title: Admission Link Label
fields.description: Label for the link through to /tickets, e.g. 'See ticket prices and book'.

fields.name: faqContactNote
fields.title: FAQ — Contact Prompt
fields.description: Shown under the questions, above the link to the contact page.

fields.name: confirmations
fields.title: Confirmation Status
fields.description: Controls the pending / research marker beside each block. Set a block to Confirmed only once the show committee has signed that detail off.

newObjectTypes._comment: All five live in sanity/schemas/objects/ and are registered in sanity/schemas/index.ts under the Objects group, alongside portableText and showVenue.

fields.name: distance
fields.title: Approximate Distance
fields.description: Free text so it can read 'about 22 km' rather than a false-precision number.

accommodationOption.title: Accommodation Option

fields.name: distanceBand
fields.title: Distance From Venue
fields.description: walking = under 1 km · nearby = 1–3 km · city = 3–10 km · further = over 10 km

accommodationOption.prohibited: No price, star-rating or 'show rate' field. SAOC has negotiated no rates and must not appear to have done so.

fields.name: label
fields.title: Day or Period
fields.description: e.g. a named show day. Free text, because the show's day structure is not confirmed.

confirmationStatuses.title: Confirmation Statuses
confirmationStatuses._comment: Thirteen identical string fields. Build them with a small local map over the block names rather than thirteen hand-written defineField blocks — same options list, same initialValue, one place to change.

list.title: Research — our own verified research, not committee-confirmed
Confirmed — signed off by the show committee

registration.schemaIndex: sanity/schemas/index.ts — showVisitorInfo in the Singletons group; showFaq in the Collections group; showVenue, travelRoute, accommodationOption, attraction, emergencyContact, openingHoursEntry, confirmationStatuses in the Objects group.
registration.structure: sanity/structure.ts — add 'showVisitorInfo' to PINNED_SINGLETON_TYPES and SINGLETON_TITLES ('Show Visitor Information'); add 'showFaq' to COLLECTION_TYPES.
